Class MenuBarPanel

java.lang.Object
qcs.view.MenuBarPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventBus.EventListener
public class MenuBarPanel extends Object implements EventBus.EventListener
MenuBarPanel handles the menu bar UI and its actions. It supports New Project, Open, Save, Exit, Settings, and Help menus, and updates dynamically with language and mode changes.
